title: Edition
description: One day's news. Each story runs in the one format its `segment` names — ಸುದ್ದಿ ಸಾರ, ಮುಖ್ಯ ಸುದ್ದಿ or ಸ್ಪೀಡ್ ನ್ಯೂಸ್ (D92).

stories.description: In priority order. Per-format counts are tokens.Limits (saara_*, roundup_*, mukhya_*).

schema_version.description: The shape of this file. Bumped when a field is added or its meaning changes, so an old edition can be read — or refused — knowingly. Absent means 1.
